name: Presence
description: Keeps children mounted through their exit transition before unmounting them.

anatomy.description: The div that keeps children mounted while their exit transition runs.
Children flagged data-state="closed" until transitionend, then unmounted.

dos: Move focus out of exiting content before setting present to false.
Drive the enter and exit CSS from the data-state hooks.
Keep exit transitions short so content does not linger after dismissal.
donts: Don't use it without an exit animation; plain conditional rendering is simpler.
Don't wrap large, frequently updating subtrees; each exit defers unmount.
Don't depend on transitions deep in the subtree; style the direct child.

examples.title: Fading card
examples.description: A card that fades out: it stays mounted with data-state="closed" until the opacity transition ends.

examples.title: Removable filter chip
examples.description: A filter indicator that animates away instead of disappearing instantly.

guidance.useWhen: Content needs an exit animation — a fade, slide, or scale — before it leaves the DOM.
guidance.avoidWhen: Simple conditional rendering with no exit animation; plain {show && <Content />} is enough.
guidance.behavior: Exposes data-state="open" while present and data-state="closed" during the exit, then unmounts on transitionend (or immediately when there is no transition) and calls onExitComplete.
guidance.responsive: Renders a plain div wrapper; layout responsibility stays with the children.

notes: Content that is animating out remains in the DOM briefly; move focus elsewhere before setting present to false so it is not lost when the node unmounts.

props.description: Called after the exit transition finishes and the children unmount.
props.name: onExitComplete

props.description: Whether the children should be shown.
props.name: present

props.description: Content kept mounted through its exit transition.
props.name: children
